review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped for uses of its main lemmas. ker_lsingle is already @[simp], and its form (ker = ⊥) is a sound normal form. The other lemmas are not simp-shaped. Several are inequalities or Disjoint statements with complicated iSup/iInf sides. range_lmapDomain, span_single_eq_top, and the exists_finset and mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset lemmas are used only through explicit rw or direct application. The one candidate was span_single_image. Its form, span (single a '' s) = map (lsingle a) (span s), matches the existing simp lemma Submodule.span_image, which is stated for `⇑f '' s`. But it has no simp-based users in the repo, so I could not justify adding @[simp]. I saw no competing rules, rewrite loops, or unwanted expansion. I could not run Lean, so a missing simp rule that only shows up in downstream files outside the greps is still possible.
